newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks recovers in low volume session.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks recovers in low volume session.

text.p: Dhaka stocks on Wednesday made a quick recovery as a big drop on Tuesday left prices attractive, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index rose 16.31 points or 1.69 percent to 976.57. Turnover slumped to 31.2 million taka from Tuesday's 46.2 million.
"Yesterday's (Tuesday) drop made prices attractive overnight. This helped the quick recovery despite comparatively thin turnout of retailers," said one broker.
Bangladesh Oxygen Ltd rose 1.71 taka to 148.25 and Chittagong Cement gained 30.79 to 1,632.12. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
